race.comment: TRIPLE YES (2) was only plain at Muswellbrook when near the top of betting but this is easier. Her Tuncurry second two back reads well for this, and the return to Class 1 company gives her a clear chance to rebound. DIRTY DOES IT (5) is the main danger, having been beaten just over a length as favourite at Bowraville after early contact, with his prior Coffs Harbour fourth also carrying merit after interference. PRIZE WRITER (4) improved into fourth last start, so she has upside third-up if the this trip suits. LILY BOBTAIL (8) resumes from a long break, but her narrow Port Macquarie placing and recent Scone trial keep her in the mix for the minor end at least. ROSENBLUM (7) has mixed his form since resuming but was a good all the way winner here two back. Keeping safe.
